title: The Cat Steals the Show
description: A shy house cat has wandered onto the school talent-show stage. The judges are arriving, the microphone is squeaking, and the cat has started tap dancing on a drum.
objective: Build a three-part story that gets the talent show back on track.
special_condition: Give the cat a surprisingly helpful role.

title: The Homework Alibi
description: A student arrives with a homework excuse involving a runaway scooter, a talking parrot, and a suspiciously clean backpack.
objective: Tell a three-step story that explains what really happened.
special_condition: End with an honest confession or a clever twist.

title: A First Date Goes Sideways
description: Two people meet at a noodle shop. A robot waiter brings soup in a flowerpot while a marching band practices in the kitchen.
objective: Help the characters connect and escape the noisy restaurant.

title: The World's Slowest Office Escape
description: An employee is trying to leave work, but every time they reach the door, the boss asks for one more tiny favor. A goat has joined the team meeting.
objective: Create a funny but fair solution for everyone.

title: The World's Worst Heist
description: A crew tries to steal a giant chocolate coin from a museum. Their getaway vehicle is a library cart with one squeaky wheel.
objective: Turn the failed plan into a harmless win.
special_condition: Keep the story school-appropriate and nobody gets hurt.

title: The Principal's Mysterious Pet
description: A tiny creature has been spotted in the principal's office. Every witness describes a different animal, and the school newspaper is about to publish.
objective: Find out what the creature is and clear up the rumors.
special_condition: Use a clue from an earlier sentence.

title: The School Bus to Mars
description: A navigation glitch sends the class bus toward a pretend Mars camp. The driver is calm, the students are excited, and the snacks are floating.
objective: Get everyone safely home with a story worth telling.

title: Pancake Day Disaster
description: The school breakfast club's pancake machine will not stop. Pancakes are covering the gym floor just as the principal walks in wearing new shoes.
objective: Stop the pancake flood and save breakfast.

title: Midnight at the Museum (Almost)
description: A class visits a museum after hours. A dinosaur model's voice box is stuck on karaoke mode, and a sleepy security guard is humming along.
objective: Solve the mystery without frightening the guard.

title: An Alien's First School Day
description: A friendly alien visits class and mistakes the bell for a snack timer. The class has one period to explain school before the alien's ship returns.
objective: Help the visitor feel welcome and learn one school rule.
special_condition: Show patience when something is misunderstood.
